originalTitle: Global Semiconductor Markets Shift as Advanced Chip Manufacturing Expands in Asia
originalContent: The global semiconductor industry is experiencing a significant shift as leading foundry manufacturers accelerate investment in next-generation extreme ultraviolet lithography infrastructure. Demand for high-performance computing components has driven revenues to record levels despite supply chain bottlenecks. Industry analysts emphasize that geopolitical diversification and regional subvention programs will shape capital expenditure strategies over the coming decade.
